proof_summary: Gamma duplication and shift formulas convert the gamma quotient into a factorial/odd-product quotient; removing the factors divisible by \(p\) then expresses its successive ratio as shifted blocks of \(p\)-adic units, with a parity split and an exact Morley-type half-system product identity absorbing the odd-product and powers-of-two terms. Reindexing the units by \(u\mapsto 2u\pmod{p^r}\) and \(u\mapsto p^r-u\) gives valuations at least \(r\) and \(2r\) for the reciprocal-square and reciprocal sums, respectively, so the quadratic expansion of every block \(\prod_u(1+\Delta/u)\), where \(p^r\mid\Delta\), is \(1\) modulo \(p^{3r}\); combining the blocks and using integrality gives the desired divisibility.
